source.title: WEC Leader Announcement (October 2022)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Committee Leader. Enzo Mattos will become the new Leader of the WCA Ethics Committee (WEC). Enzo was already working as a member of the WEC.

Enzo was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote among the current Committee Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our [Motion](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0 - Committees and Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams.

We thank Blake Thompson for the work he has done for the WEC, and wish Enzo the best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

Enzo was among two applicants we had and his candidacy document can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1FyswkuRj2DzbUzUyZrv_26Wh75vyroCF) if you are interested in viewing it. 

The Board received applications from the following applicants:

* Shamika Dalvi

We would like to thank Shamika for applying.

translation.title: WCA 道德委员会负责人任命公告（2022 年 10 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，Enzo Mattos 将担任 WCA 道德委员会（WEC）的新负责人。Enzo 此前已是 WEC 成员。

按照关于 WCA 委员会和团队的[议案](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0 - Committees and Teams.pdf)第 4 节，WCA 董事会选定 Enzo，并经现任委员会负责人和高级代表投票批准。

感谢 Blake Thompson 为 WEC 所做的工作，祝 Enzo 履新顺利。

本次共有两位申请人，Enzo 是其中之一。如有兴趣，可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1FyswkuRj2DzbUzUyZrv_26Wh75vyroCF)查看他的申请材料。

董事会还收到了以下申请人的材料：

* Shamika Dalvi

感谢 Shamika 参与申请。
